test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which of the following years did the Muslim League pass a resolution demanding a measure of autonomy for the Muslim majority areas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1940.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The** Muslim League** advocated autonomy for the areas of the **subcontinent with a majority of Muslims**, which were the geographically adjacent territories in the** North-West and the East,** in its **1940 Resolution.**
